title: StageTemplate
description: A designed encounter skeleton. Templates fix difficulty shape and randomization ranges; they never specify the player's deck army (that comes from the deck) or any rarity. Enemy squares are generated, except in a placement: fixed template, which hand-places the enemy army for set-piece stages. See docs/04-stage-generation-and-authoring.md.

mateIn.description: Inclusive [min,max] par: the target Mate in X, drawn per stage from the stage seed (docs/04 §2). min <= max.

spawnPoints.description: Optional: lowers the stage's spawn-point budget (economy.yaml rules.spawnPoints for this act and tier). Never raises it.

enemyArmy.description: Inclusive [min,max] counts per enemy piece type, excluding the king (always exactly 1).

placement.description: generated: enemyArmy is rolled and placed in enemyZone. fixed: fixedEnemy gives every enemy square by hand (tutorial and set-piece stages); the solver still validates it against the player's actual deck (docs/04 §2).

fixedEnemy.description: placement: fixed only. Every enemy piece, king included, by square.

enemyZone.description: Ranks the enemy army may occupy. Never a deployment rank (economy.yaml rules.deploymentRanks, ranks 1-4): the player's half belongs to the player.

spawnedPawns.description: Free, stage-only pawns spawned for the player (docs/02 §2.2). Rarity comes from data/economy.yaml → rarity.pool, never from the template.

count.description: Inclusive [min,max] number of spawned pawns. min must be >= 1.

ranks.description: Ranks the pawns may spawn on. Must not overlap enemyZone. May overlap the deployment ranks (1-4): a spawned pawn simply occupies its square.

designNote.description: What this template is meant to teach or test.

line.description: Required when type is 'scripted'. Enemy moves as from+to squares, e.g. 'e8e7'.

fallbackDepth.description: best_move depth used once a scripted line breaks or runs out (docs/02 §8.1). Defaults to enemyAI.search.defaultFallbackDepth.

allOf.$comment: Generated templates roll and place their enemy; fixed templates hand-place it.
